tasks.title: Author .devcontainer/postCreate.sh (idempotent install of 5 OSS-local servers)
tasks.description: Bash invoked by devcontainer.json postCreateCommand. Per ADR-0041 v1.0.1 hybrid posture + sentinel+binary-presence pattern: source versions.env; for each of 5 OSS-local servers check `sentinel + binary present`; install on miss (serena via `uvx --from`; mcp-openapi-schema via `npx -y`; actionlint-mcp via `go install github.com/hongkongkiwi/actionlint-mcp@${ACTIONLINT_MCP_SHA}` — identifier corrected per cycle-3 D-3.2 F1; was 2manymws/...; terraform-mcp via T3.3 script; **gitnexus via `npm install -g gitnexus@${GITNEXUS_TAG}` with `GITNEXUS_SKIP_OPTIONAL_GRAMMARS=1` exported BEFORE the install runs, then `npx -y gitnexus@${GITNEXUS_TAG} --help` smoke-test — install mechanism corrected per cycle-3 D-3.2 F2; was uvx-form which assumed PyPI publication that does not exist**). Prereq: Node-LTS on PATH at postCreate time (provided by the `node:1@20` Feature; verified by AC-CS-1). On per-server install failure: stderr + exit 1 (AC-CS-3). Write install_complete event per server (redacted per ADR-0039). End with MCP_AUTH_PROBE=1 invocation. Print AC-FR-8-a consolidated `MCP health: <N>/7 connected`. **AC-CS-9 wrapping-intent preservation**: the `GITNEXUS_SKIP_OPTIONAL_GRAMMARS=1` env-var still does the same load-bearing work (suppresses npm's vendored tree-sitter grammar build under the corrected npm path); the verify-at-execution check (T0.4) asserts no C++ toolchain in install-process tree — install-command-agnostic.
tasks.sub_decomposition_decision: Retained as single L-sized node. The 5 per-server install paths share the sentinel+binary-presence pattern and a single fail-fast harness; splitting per-server would duplicate the harness 5× and create false serialization. PV-3 validators verify the script as a unit.

critical_path_notes: Longest dependency chain per Plan §Critical Path. T0.1 chosen as the Phase 0 representative because T1.3 (its closest downstream consumer in Phase 1) depends on T0.1+T0.2+T0.3+T0.4; T0.1 has the largest L3 cost (Terraform GPG verify smoke). Phase 0 tasks are all-parallel so picking the longest is informational, not load-bearing.

phase_1_parallel_clusters.rationale: T1.3 + T1.5 do not share files; T1.3 depends on Phase 0 pin values, T1.5 only on T1.1
T1.4 needs T0.9 + benefits from T1.3 stability

parallelization_summary.phase_2_chain: T2.1 → T2.2 must serialize (assets/templates depends on SKILL.md pedagogical_sections shape); T2.3 can parallelize with T2.2 (only depends on T2.1 frontmatter for sister cross-ref); T2.4 must wait for T2.2 (template).

phase_3_parallel_clusters.rationale: Independent scripts; mcp-ping.sh + terraform-mcp.sh do not overlap
postCreate must complete + binaries on PATH before postStart can probe; postStart consumes mcp-events.jsonl schema from T2.3 and ping primitive from T3.1

phase_4_parallel_clusters.rationale: Independent file groups: T4.1 edits 8 agent files; T4.4 edits auditing-mcp/SKILL.md; T4.5 edits auditing-cc-configs/SKILL.md; T4.7 writes verify-at-execution.md §OI-4. T4.7 depends on T4.1 for final per-agent overhead numbers — so T4.1 → T4.7 serializes; the others remain parallel

phase_4_parallel_clusters.note: T4.3 also depends on T2.1, T2.3, T2.4, T3.4, T3.5 — usually completed before Phase 4 starts

parallelization_summary.phase_5_serial_chain: T5.1 → T5.2 → T5.3 → T5.4 → T5.5 → T5.6 + T5.7 (T5.6 needs T1.2; T5.7 needs all prior Phase 5 tasks). Phase 5 is inherently serial because each smoke consumes the live state of the previous.
